verdict.rationale: The reemployment-tax eServices page offers a Document Lookup that uses the tax number, FEIN/ITIN and confirmation number to 'Look Up Returns or Payments', plus a return and payment history view. This gives some status visibility for submitted filings. However, the business-tax registration application sits behind an authenticated login, and nothing shows a lookup for application or case status on public pages. Missing for 10: application/registration status lookup, case status lookup, confirmation that the filing lookup works without login and shows processing status rather than just the document, and coverage of tax types beyond reemployment tax.

support.subject: As a founder, I can look up the status of my filing, application, or case from the service's public pages
